common_rules_zones_1_4.rule: Zones 1-4 common provisions: H measured from mean adjacent ground; same gabarit on all faces except murs en attente; widest street governs; building-to-building distance = sum of boundary distances; roof gabarit 35°/4.80 m.

zones.label: Zone 1
zones.sitg_desc_zone: La 1ère zone est destinée aux grandes maisons affectées à l'habitation, au commerce et aux activités du secteur tertiaire (gabarit max. 24 m). Elle comprend les quartiers de la Ville de Genève qui se trouvent dans les limites des anciennes fortifications.

use.text: Large buildings for housing, commerce and tertiary activities; other non-nuisance activities admissible. Zone 1 = quarters of the Ville de Genève inside the former fortifications (in SITG: Saint-Gervais, Rues Basses, Tour-de-l'Île).

height.street_formula: H <= 5/4*D + 3 (D = distance between alignments); if D < 12 m: H <= 5/3*D + 3 and <= 18 m

roof.rule: One habitable roof level within the roof gabarit: horizontal base line from the top of the facade gabarit (+ max 1.50 m projection), 35° oblique line, ridge max 4.80 m above base line.

distance.between_buildings: sum of each building's boundary distance (LCI 45 al.1)

contiguous.rule: Building on the boundary of two private properties is allowed (mur en attente may require a plan d'ensemble).

density.note: No floor-area ratio in zones 1-4: buildable volume = gabarit envelope.

underground.rule: No statutory cap on underground floor area in zones 1-4; geotechnical report required for deep works (>4 m or several basement levels). Underground works count nowhere in gabarit.

plq_effect.rule: Ordinary zone: no PLQ needed; if a PLQ (LExt) or règlement de quartier covers the parcel, its gabarits, implantation and distances prevail (heights reserved in LCI 19/23/27/32; distances reserved in LCI 45 al.3).

special_regulation.text: Zone 1 itself is not a protected zone; protected sectors overlay it (Vieille-Ville LCI 83-88 via RDPPF_ZP; Rôtisserie-Pélisserie LCI 93A-93B applies arts 18-21 and 35-57; ensembles XIXe LCI 89-93).
